ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is an aldehyde group; the aldehyde carbon is connected to an explicitly marked H and forms a double bond with O; this aldehyde carbon is further connected to an adjacent carbon, on which an H is also explicitly marked. This carbon continues to connect to a methylene group, and the methylene group connects to an oxygen atom; this oxygen atom connects to the benzene ring on the right side. The benzene ring is para-connected to an NO2 substituent. The curved arrow and BSA label in the figure indicate the reaction process, and the problem requires ignoring the arrow. Reasoning: Transcribing as an ordinary molecule, the left aldehyde group is written as [H]C(=O), the adjacent carbon connected to it and bearing explicit H is C([H]), followed by the methylene-oxygen fragment as CO. The p-nitrophenyl group connected through oxygen on the right can be written as c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1. Therefore the overall SMILES is [H]C(=O)C([H])COc1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Transcribe the displayed transition-state structure as an ordinary molecule. Start at the left aldehyde as [H]C(=O), connect it to the adjacent carbon shown bearing H as C([H]), continue to the methylene attached to oxygen as CO, then encode the para-nitrophenyl group attached through oxygen as c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1. Concatenate these fragments according to the visible bonds to obtain [H]C(=O)C([H])COc1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个醛基，醛碳连接一个显式标出的H并与O形成双键；该醛碳再连接到相邻的碳，该相邻碳上也显式标出一个H。这个碳继续连接到一个亚甲基，亚甲基连接到一个氧原子；该氧原子连接到右侧苯环。苯环对位连接一个NO2取代基。图中的弯箭头和BSA标注表示反应过程，题目要求忽略箭头。推理：按普通分子转写，左侧醛基写为[H]C(=O)，连接到带显式H的相邻碳为C([H])，再接亚甲基-氧片段为CO。右侧通过氧连接的对硝基苯基可写为c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1。因此整体SMILES为[H]C(=O)C([H])COc1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1。
